critic.fix_suggestion: Relocate the engine primitives from the center of the wing to an outboard position. Specifically, translate each engine primitive 15% forward along the longitudinal axis and 20% outward toward the wingtip relative to the current center-point. This will align the engines with the reference model's forward-and-outward placement while maintaining the existing geometry scale.
